# telnyx_phone_number_enable_emergency (Action)

Enables or disables emergency services on a phone number with an emergency address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn on emergency calling for a number once its address exists. Needs
# Terraform 1.14 or later.
resource "terraform_data" "emergency" {
  input = telnyx_address.office.id

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.telnyx_phone_number_enable_emergency.main]
    }
  }
}

action "telnyx_phone_number_enable_emergency" "main" {
  config {
    id                   = telnyx_phone_number.main.id
    emergency_enabled    = true
    emergency_address_id = telnyx_address.office.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emergency_address_id` (String) Identifies the address to be used with emergency services.
- `emergency_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether to enable emergency services on this number.
- `id` (String) The object's id.
